GENRA CHOP 2.6.0 – a hip-hop beat generator for VCV Rack 2 with four modules: **GENRA CHOP**, **GENRA CHOP GRID**, **GENRA CHOP ABLAUF** and **GENRA CHOP FX**.

### New since 2.4.0
- **LOOP** (2.5.0, in the WARP strip): the whole sample loops in time instead of the chop pattern (AUTO or 1–16 bars), the pads stay playable; ABLAUF keeps LOOP per pad, so one part can loop and the next one chop
- **Cut by hand** (2.6.0): drag a chop line in the waveform window to move a cut (snaps to the quietest point), double-click a line to remove a chop, double-click elsewhere to add one; UNDO takes it back
- **Drums / DENS** (2.5.0): hi-hats come earlier, the clap layer and the tambourine only now and then; in BREAK / BOTH, clap, rim and perc no longer play snare-like pieces
- **Follow GENRA** (2.6.0): the GENRA instruments (DRUM-X, SCHLAG, GRUND, FUNKE, SCHMELZ …) can follow GENRA CHOP without cables – needs GENRA / GENRA Instruments 2.39.0 or newer
- **GENRA CHOP FX** (2.6.0): sound and clock from GENRA CHOP without cables (right-click), the effects level-matched to the dry signal, the bus effect fields readable again

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Camillowup/Genra-Chop/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) (German), manual: [README.md](https://github.com/Camillowup/Genra-Chop/blob/main/README.md)

### Downloads
- `…-win-x64.vcvplugin` – Windows
- `…-mac-x64.vcvplugin` – Mac with Intel processor
- `…-mac-arm64.vcvplugin` – Mac with Apple silicon (M1 and later)

Install: put the `.vcvplugin` file into Rack's `plugins` folder (Rack › Help › Open user folder) and restart Rack.
